question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：巴拿马 vs 英格兰（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: Panama vs England (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 英格兰实力碾压、约三分之二概率取胜，但末轮轮换可能与巴拿马核心带伤令平局空间略升，巴拿马爆冷空间有限。
one_liner_en: England's class dominates with roughly a two-thirds win probability; possible matchday-3 rotation and Panama's injured playmaker slightly lift the draw, while Panama's upset ceiling stays low.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 294 分（英格兰 2024 vs 巴拿马 1730），Davidson 模型基准给出英胜约 67%。
key_reasons.en: A 294-point Elo gap (England 2024 vs Panama 1730) yields a ~67% England-win baseline in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 英格兰 26 人名单接近全主力，仅边后卫线有轻微伤病隐患，凯恩领衔。
key_reasons.en: England's 26-man squad is near full strength with only minor fullback fitness flags, led by Harry Kane.

key_reasons.cn: 末轮英格兰或已出线存在轮换可能；巴拿马核心卡拉斯基利亚带腹股沟伤，压制爆冷上限。
key_reasons.en: England may already be qualified by matchday 3 (rotation plausible); Panama playmaker Carrasquilla carries a groin injury, capping the upset ceiling.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 12.4/20.2/67.4, plus a bounded evidence-based adjustment (~2pp total, cap +/-8pp), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.
